ours: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simons house. And Simons wifes mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.
theirs: And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her.

ours: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simons, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.
theirs: And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship.

ours: When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.
theirs: When Simon Peter saw [it], he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord.

ours: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judæa, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them.
theirs: And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was [present] to heal them.

ours: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon called Zelotes,
theirs: Matthew and Thomas, James the [son] of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,

ours: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judæa and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
theirs: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;

ours: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of mans sake.
theirs: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you [from their company], and shall reproach [you], and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.

ours: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brothers eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
theirs: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

ours: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brothers eye.
theirs: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.

ours: And a certain centurions servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.
theirs: And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

ours: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judæa, and throughout all the region round about.
theirs: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.

ours: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings courts.
theirs: But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

ours: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisees house, and sat down to meat.
theirs: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to meat.

ours: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisees house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,
theirs: And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that [Jesus] sat at meat in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment,

ours: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herods steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
theirs: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.

ours: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
theirs: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:

ours: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogues house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
theirs: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue's [house], saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.

ours: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Fathers, and of the holy angels.
theirs: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and [in his] Father's, and of the holy angels.

ours: For the Son of man is not come to destroy mens lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
theirs: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save [them]. And they went to another village.

ours: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus feet, and heard his word.
theirs: And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

ours: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a mans life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
theirs: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.

ours: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Fathers good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
theirs: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

ours: And that servant, which knew his lords will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
theirs: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not [himself], neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many [stripes].

ours: THERE were present at that season some that told him of the Galilæans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.
theirs: There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.

ours: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilæans were sinners above all the Galilæans, because they suffered such things?
theirs: And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things?

ours: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my fathers have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!
theirs: And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger!

ours: So he called every one of his lords debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
theirs: So he called every one of his lord's debtors [unto him], and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?

ours: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another mans, who shall give you that which is your own?
theirs: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own?

ours: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich mans table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.
theirs: And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

ours: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abrahams bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;
theirs: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

ours: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my fathers house:
theirs: Then he said, I pray thee therefore, father, that thou wouldest send him to my father's house:

ours: Remember Lots wife.
theirs: Remember Lot's wife.

ours: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needles eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
theirs: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

ours: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of Gods sake,
theirs: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake,

ours: And, behold, there was a man named Zacchæus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.
theirs: And, behold, [there was] a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich.

ours: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.
theirs: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; for to day I must abide at thy house.

ours: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.
theirs: And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore [him] fourfold.

ours: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?
theirs: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?

ours: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Cæsars.
theirs: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar's.

ours: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsars, and unto God the things which be Gods.
theirs: And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's.

ours: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any mans brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
theirs: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

ours: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is Davids son?
theirs: And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son?

ours: Which devour widows houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
theirs: Which devour widows' houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.

ours: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my names sake.
theirs: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute [you], delivering [you] up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake.

ours: And ye shall be hated of all men for my names sake.
theirs: And ye shall be hated of all [men] for my name's sake.

ours: Then let them which are in Judæa flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
theirs: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

ours: Mens hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
theirs: Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.

ours: And he was withdrawn from them about a stones cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,
theirs: And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed,

ours: Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priests house. And Peter followed afar off.
theirs: Then took they him, and led [him], and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

ours: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilæan.
theirs: And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Of a truth this [fellow] also was with him: for he is a Galilaean.

ours: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Cæsar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.
theirs: And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this [fellow] perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King.

ours: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilæan.
theirs: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean.

ours: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herods jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.
theirs: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

ours: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathæa, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.
theirs: (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) [he was] of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God.

ours: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoes latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
theirs: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose.

ours: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peters brother.
theirs: One of the two which heard John [speak], and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

ours: And the Jews passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,
theirs: And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

ours: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers money, and overthrew the tables;
theirs: And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables;

ours: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Fathers house an house of merchandise.
theirs: And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things hence; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise.

ours: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mothers womb, and be born?
theirs: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

ours: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judæa; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
theirs: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.

ours: And John also was baptizing in Ænon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
theirs: And John also was baptizing in AEnon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.

ours: Then there arose a question between some of Johns disciples and the Jews about purifying.
theirs: Then there arose a question between [some] of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.

ours: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegrooms voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
theirs: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.

ours: He left Judæa, and departed again into Galilee.
theirs: He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

ours: Now Jacobs well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
theirs: Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with [his] journey, sat thus on the well: [and] it was about the sixth hour.

ours: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilæans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
theirs: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.

ours: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judæa into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
theirs: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.

ours: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judæa into Galilee.
theirs: This [is] again the second miracle [that] Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.

ours: I am come in my Fathers name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.
theirs: I am come in my Father's name, and ye receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him ye will receive.

ours: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peters brother, saith unto him,
theirs: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, saith unto him,

ours: And this is the Fathers will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.
theirs: And this is the Father's will which hath sent me, that of all which he hath given me I should lose nothing, but should raise it up again at the last day.

ours: Now the Jews feast of tabernacles was at hand.
theirs: Now the Jews' feast of tabernacles was at hand.

ours: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judæa, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.
theirs: His brethren therefore said unto him, Depart hence, and go into Judaea, that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest.

ours: They answered him, We be Abrahams seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?
theirs: They answered him, We be Abraham's seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?

ours: I know that ye are Abrahams seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.
theirs: I know that ye are Abraham's seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.

ours: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abrahams children, ye would do the works of Abraham.
theirs: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham's children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

ours: He that is of God heareth Gods words: ye therefore hear them not, because ye are not of God.
theirs: He that is of God heareth God's words: ye therefore hear [them] not, because ye are not of God.

ours: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses disciples.
theirs: Then they reviled him, and said, Thou art his disciple; but we are Moses' disciples.

ours: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomons porch.
theirs: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon's porch.

ours: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Fathers name, they bear witness of me.
theirs: Jesus answered them, I told you, and ye believed not: the works that I do in my Father's name, they bear witness of me.

ours: My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Fathers hand.
theirs: My Father, which gave [them] me, is greater than all; and no [man] is able to pluck [them] out of my Father's hand.

ours: Then after that saith he to his disciples, Let us go into Judæa again.
theirs: Then after that saith he to [his] disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.

ours: And the Jews passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
theirs: And the Jews' passover was nigh at hand: and many went out of the country up to Jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.

ours: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simons son, which should betray him,
theirs: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon's [son], which should betray him,

ours: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
theirs: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

ours: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an asss colt.
theirs: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass's colt.

ours: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simons son, to betray him;
theirs: And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's [son], to betray him;

ours: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.
theirs: After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe [them] with the towel wherewith he was girded.

ours: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one anothers feet.
theirs: If I then, [your] Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

ours: Now there was leaning on Jesus bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
theirs: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

ours: He then lying on Jesus breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?
theirs: He then lying on Jesus' breast saith unto him, Lord, who is it?

ours: In my Fathers house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
theirs: In my Father's house are many mansions: if [it were] not [so], I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

ours: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works sake.
theirs: Believe me that I [am] in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake.

ours: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Fathers which sent me.
theirs: He that loveth me not keepeth not my sayings: and the word which ye hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me.

ours: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Fathers commandments, and abide in his love.
theirs: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love.

ours: But all these things will they do unto you for my names sake, because they know not him that sent me.
theirs: But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me.

ours: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priests servant, and cut off his right ear. The servants name was Malchus.
theirs: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

ours: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also one of this mans disciples? He saith, I am not.
theirs: Then saith the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Art not thou also [one] of this man's disciples? He saith, I am not.

ours: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Cæsars friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Cæsar.
theirs: And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If thou let this man go, thou art not Caesar's friend: whosoever maketh himself a king speaketh against Caesar.

ours: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cæsar.
theirs: But they cried out, Away with [him], away with [him], crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar.

ours: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mothers sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.
theirs: Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the [wife] of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene.

ours: And after this Joseph of Arimathæa, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.
theirs: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave [him] leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus.

ours: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews preparation day; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.
theirs: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation [day]; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand.

ours: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fishers coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.
theirs: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt [his] fisher's coat [unto him], (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea.

ours: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
theirs: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

ours: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath days journey.
theirs: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey.

ours: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphæus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James.
theirs: And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James [the son] of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas [the brother] of James.

ours: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilæans?
theirs: And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans?

ours: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judæa, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
theirs: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

ours: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judæa, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:

theirs: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

theirs: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

ours: And laid them down at the apostles feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.

theirs: Having land, sold [it], and brought the money, and laid [it] at the apostles' feet.

ours: And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles feet.
theirs: And kept back [part] of the price, his wife also being privy [to it], and brought a certain part, and laid [it] at the apostles' feet.

ours: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomons porch.
theirs: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

ours: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this mans blood upon us.
theirs: Saying, Did not we straitly command you that ye should not teach in this name? and, behold, ye have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us.

theirs: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein ye now dwell.

theirs: And at the second [time] Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh.

theirs: In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months:

ours: And when he was cast out, Pharaohs daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.
theirs: And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

ours: And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young mans feet, whose name was Saul.
theirs: And cast [him] out of the city, and stoned [him]: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul.

ours: AND Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judæa and Samaria, except the apostles.
theirs: And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles.

ours: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,
theirs: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Ghost was given, he offered them money,

theirs: But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.

ours: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my names sake.
theirs: For I will shew him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake.

ours: Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Cæsarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.
theirs: [Which] when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

theirs: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost, were multiplied.

ours: And there he found a certain man named Æneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.
theirs: And there he found a certain man named AEneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy.

ours: And Peter said unto him, Æneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.
theirs: And Peter said unto him, AEneas, Jesus Christ maketh thee whole: arise, and make thy bed. And he arose immediately.

ours: THERE was a certain man in Cæsarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,
theirs: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian [band],

ours: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simons house, and stood before the gate,
theirs: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made inquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate,

ours: And the morrow after they entered into Cæsarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.
theirs: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and had called together his kinsmen and near friends.

ours: That word, I say, ye know, which was published throughout all Judæa, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;
theirs: That word, [I say], ye know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

ours: AND the apostles and brethren that were in Judæa heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.
theirs: And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

ours: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Cæsarea unto me.
theirs: And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me.

ours: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the mans house:
theirs: And the spirit bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house:

ours: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Cæsar.
theirs: And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar.

ours: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judæa:
theirs: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

ours: And when she knew Peters voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.
theirs: And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate.

ours: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judæa to Cæsarea, and there abode.
theirs: And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that [they] should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and [there] abode.

ours: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the kings chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the kings country.
theirs: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's [country].

ours: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar-jesus:
theirs: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name [was] Barjesus:

ours: Of this mans seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:
theirs: Of this man's seed hath God according to [his] promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus:

ours: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mothers womb, who never had walked:
theirs: And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked:

ours: AND certain men which came down from Judæa taught the brethren, and said, Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.
theirs: And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, [and said], Except ye be circumcised after the manner of Moses, ye cannot be saved.

ours: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every ones bands were loosed.
theirs: And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed.

ours: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Cæsar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
theirs: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, [one] Jesus.

ours: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
theirs: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, [Ye] men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

ours: Neither is worshipped with mens hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
theirs: Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;

ours: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and mans device.
theirs: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man's device.

ours: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain mans house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.
theirs: And he departed thence, and entered into a certain [man's] house, named Justus, [one] that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

ours: And when he had landed at Cæsarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
theirs: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.

ours: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto Johns baptism.
theirs: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.

ours: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Pauls companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
theirs: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

ours: For we are in danger to be called in question for this days uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
theirs: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.

ours: I have coveted no mans silver, or gold, or apparel.
theirs: I have coveted no man's silver, or gold, or apparel.

ours: And they all wept sore, and fell on Pauls neck, and kissed him,
theirs: And they all wept sore, and fell on Paul's neck, and kissed him,

ours: And the next day we that were of Pauls company departed, and came unto Cæsarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
theirs: And the next [day] we that were of Paul's company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was [one] of the seven; and abode with him.

ours: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judæa a certain prophet, named Agabus.
theirs: And as we tarried [there] many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.

ours: And when he was come unto us, he took Pauls girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
theirs: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul's girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver [him] into the hands of the Gentiles.

ours: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Cæsarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
theirs: There went with us also [certain] of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.

ours: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou Gods high priest?
theirs: And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God's high priest?

ours: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.
theirs: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes [that were] of the Pharisees' part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

ours: And when Pauls sisters son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.
theirs: And when Paul's sister's son heard of their lying in wait, he went and entered into the castle, and told Paul.

ours: And he called unto him two centurions, saying, Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Cæsarea, and horsemen threescore and ten, and spearmen two hundred, at the third hour of the night;

ours: Who, when they came to Cæsarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.
theirs: Who, when they came to Caesarea, and delivered the epistle to the governor, presented Paul also before him.

ours: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herods judgment hall.
theirs: I will hear thee, said he, when thine accusers are also come. And he commanded him to be kept in Herod's judgment hall.

ours: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.
theirs: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix' room: and Felix, willing to shew the Jews a pleasure, left Paul bound.

ours: NOW when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Cæsarea to Jerusalem.
theirs: Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

ours: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Cæsarea, and that he himself would depart shortly thither.
theirs: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly [thither].

ours: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Cæsarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.
theirs: And when he had tarried among them more than ten days, he went down unto Caesarea; and the next day sitting on the judgment seat commanded Paul to be brought.

ours: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Cæsar, have I offended any thing at all.
theirs: While he answered for himself, Neither against the law of the Jews, neither against the temple, nor yet against Caesar, have I offended any thing at all.

ours: Then said Paul, I stand at Cæsars judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.
theirs: Then said Paul, I stand at Caesar's judgment seat, where I ought to be judged: to the Jews have I done no wrong, as thou very well knowest.

ours: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Cæsar.
theirs: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Caesar.

ours: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Cæsar? unto Cæsar shalt thou go.
theirs: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, Hast thou appealed unto Caesar? unto Caesar shalt thou go.

ours: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Cæsarea to salute Festus.
theirs: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus.

ours: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Pauls cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:
theirs: And when they had been there many days, Festus declared Paul's cause unto the king, saying, There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix:

ours: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Cæsar.
theirs: But when Paul had appealed to be reserved unto the hearing of Augustus, I commanded him to be kept till I might send him to Caesar.

ours: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus commandment Paul was brought forth.
theirs: And on the morrow, when Agrippa was come, and Bernice, with great pomp, and was entered into the place of hearing, with the chief captains, and principal men of the city, at Festus' commandment Paul was brought forth.

ours: Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hopes sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.
theirs: Unto which [promise] our twelve tribes, instantly serving [God] day and night, hope to come. For which hope's sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

ours: But shewed first unto them of Damascus, and at Jerusalem, and throughout all the coasts of Judæa, and then to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, and do works meet for repentance.
